{{Weapon infobox | uslot = Superior Sigil of Fire | type = Torch | level = 80 | salvage = none | bound = account use | skin = Rodgort (skin); Rodgort's Flame (skin); Rodgort's Flame (original skin); Rodgort's Flame Experiment (skin) | rarity = Legendary | prefix = selectable | id = 30700 | gallery2 = Rodgort stowed.jpg | gallery2-text = Stowed. | gallery3 = Rodgort footfalls.jpg | gallery3-text = Flaming footfalls. }} [[Rodgort]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] torch crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|When Cutha woke, he was greeted by sounds of panic and flame. He ran to the window just in time to witness a [[dragon]] perch on a nearby rooftop. "Rodgort," they whispered. "Rodgort is my name."}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Rodgort's Flame | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Rodgort | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[Rodgort]] is a fiery dragon-headed torch. While drawn, the mouth of the dragon breathes fire. ;Aura * The arm wielding Rodgort is on fire with little pieces flickering away. ;Draw/Stow effects * When drawn, the sound of a fire igniting is heard. * When stowed, the sound of a fire extinguishing is heard. ;Footfalls * The user leaves behind flaming footprints. ;Kill animations * Enemies killed by Rodgort will display burning death animations. ; Skill effects * Ranged skills will throw [[Rodgort]] instead. This effect changes the following skills: ** {{r}} [[Ranger]]: [[Throw Torch]] ** {{g}} [[Guardian]]: [[Zealot's Fire]] === Gallery === File:Rodgort concept art.jpg|Concept art by [[Kekai Kotaki]]. main-hand, only the main-hand's footprint will be shown. * When Rodgort is drawn, the head of the weapon is glitching into place. == Trivia == * The name of this weapon is in reference to the skills [[gww:Rodgort's Invocation|Rodgort's Invocation]] and [[gww:Mark of Rodgort|Mark of Rodgort]] from the original Guild Wars. * Rodgort spelled backwards is [[w:Trogdor|Trogdor]], which is the name of a
